info.name: Vehicle Service Booking API
info.description:
Walks the workshop workflow: registering vehicles, services priced by vehicle type, free days, booking with overlap protection, BOOKED to IN_SERVICE to COMPLETED, history, cancellations with reasons, service management, bays, the dashboard and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8102). Repeatable: it registers a fresh customer, random vehicle numbers and books days about two months ahead.

exec: const letters = () => String.fromCharCode(65 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 26)) + String.fromCharCode(65 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 26));
const day = (offset) => { const d = new Date(Date.now() + offset * 864e5); return d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0"); };

item.name: Register a fresh customer for this run
A badly formed number is rejected

exec: pm.test("Stored as given, no services yet", () => { pm.expect(v.number).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("carNo")); pm.expect(v.type).to.eql("CAR"); pm.expect(v.completedServices).to.eql(0); });

item.name: The same number again is rejected
Another customer cannot take the number (spaces and case ignored)
The garage has no personal vehicles

exec: pm.test("Active services with an estimate", () => { pm.expect(list.length).to.be.at.least(5); list.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s.active).to.be.true; pm.expect(s.estimatedCost).to.eql(s.basePrice); }); });

pm.test("Cheaper than the car price", () => { const full = pm.response.json().find(s => s.name === "Full service"); pm.expect(full.estimatedCost).to.be.below(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("carFullCost"))); });

item.name: An unknown vehicle type is rejected
Free bays for the next days

exec: pm.test("14 days, bays add up", () => { const days = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(days.length).to.eql(14); days.forEach(d => pm.expect(d.booked + d.free).to.be.at.least(d.bays)); });

item.name: Asking for zero days is rejected
More than 90 days ahead is rejected

exec: pm.test("Booked for two days with the estimate", () => { pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("BOOKED"); pm.expect(b.days).to.eql(2); pm.expect(b.endDate > b.startDate).to.be.true; pm.expect(b.estimatedCost).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("carFullCost"))); pm.expect(b.number).to.match(/^VS-\d+$/); pm.expect(b.canCancel).to.be.true; pm.expect(b.canStart).to.be.false; });

item.name: The same vehicle cannot overlap itself
The bike may use the same day
The day now shows the two vehicles

exec: pm.test("First day has at least 2 booked", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()[0].booked).to.be.at.least(2));
pm.test("Both, soonest first", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(l[0].startDate <= l[1].startDate).to.be.true; });

item.name: The garage finds the bookings by number
A service cannot start before its day
Completing a booked vehicle is a conflict

exec: pm.test("In service by the admin", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("IN_SERVICE"); pm.expect(b.startedBy).to.eql("serviceadmin"); pm.expect(b.canCancel).to.be.false; });

item.name: The customer cannot cancel work in progress
A negative final cost is rejected
Complete it with the final bill

exec: pm.test("Completed with the bill", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("COMPLETED"); pm.expect(b.finalCost).to.eql(1450.5); pm.expect(b.completedBy).to.eql("serviceadmin"); });

item.name: The bike's history shows the finished job

exec: pm.test("One finished service with notes", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].workNotes).to.include("chain"); });

item.name: The garage finds the bike and its history count

exec: pm.test("One vehicle, one service done", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].completedServices).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].ownerUsername).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("newUser")); });

item.name: The garage reads the same history
A vehicle with bookings cannot be removed
The customer cancels with a reason

exec: pm.test("Cancelled by the customer", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("CANCELLED"); pm.expect(b.cancelReason).to.eql("Out of town"); pm.expect(b.cancelledBy).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("newUser")); });

item.name: The car can book those days again
The garage must give a reason
The garage cancels with a reason

exec: pm.test("Cancelled by the admin", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("CANCELLED"); pm.expect(b.cancelledBy).to.eql("serviceadmin"); });

item.name: The customer sees the garage's reason

exec: pm.test("Previous holds the finished and cancelled ones", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(3); pm.expect(l.find(b => b.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("secondId")).cancelReason).to.eql("Mechanic unavailable"); });

item.name: Cancel the bike's future booking too
A bad service form lists the problems
A switched-off service cannot be booked
